title: Pure Lost World
summary: The Lost World Dinosaur strategy revolves around the Field Spell Lost World: whenever a Dinosaur is Normal or Special Summoned, Lost World Special Summons a 'Jurraegg Token' to your opponent's field in Defense Position, preventing your opponent from targeting any monster on the field with card effects EXCEPT that Token! Better yet, Lost World allows you to destroy a Dinosaur in your hand or Deck whenever a Normal Monster would be destroyed. Targeting the Jurraegg Token with Souleating Oviraptor lets you destroy Babycerasaurus directly from your Deck instead—summoning a Dinosaur from your Deck while keeping the Jurraegg Token alive on their field!

allow.Megalosmasher X: Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK) that triggers Survival's End on the field to destroy Normal Monsters and summon Dinosaurs from your Deck.
allow.Scrap Raptor: Level 4 EARTH Dinosaur Tuner that destroys itself or Babycerasaurus on the field (or protects the Jurraegg Token via Lost World to pop Babycerasaurus from Deck!) and grants an extra Normal Summon.
allow.Giant Rex: Level 4 EARTH Dinosaur (2000 ATK) that Special Summons itself when banished by Miscellaneousaurus, Double Evolution Pill, or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno for an instant Rank 4 Evolzar Xyz.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the signature Lost World Field Spell.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls.
allow.Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters) that detaches 2 materials to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap activation.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters) that detaches 1 material to negate and destroy any monster effect.
allow.Pentestag: Link-2 monster that grants piercing battle damage to Ultimate Conductor Tyranno pointed to by it.

main: Lost World

Signature Field Spell: weakens non-Dinosaurs by 500 ATK/DEF; summons a Jurraegg Token to the opponent's field (protecting your Dinosaurs from targeting!); and protects any Normal Monster by destroying a Dinosaur (Babycerasaurus!) from your hand or Deck instead!
Souleating Oviraptor

Core starter: searches or dumps any Dinosaur on summon, then targets the Jurraegg Token to destroy it and revive a Dinosaur—letting Lost World protect the Token by destroying Babycerasaurus from your Deck instead!
Miscellaneousaurus

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards itself to make all Dinosaur monsters you control unaffected by activated effects, then banishes itself + Dinosaurs from GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur or Babycerasaurus from the Deck.
Babycerasaurus
Mandatory trigger when destroyed by a card effect (including directly inside your Deck by Lost World's substitution!): Special Summons any Level 4 or lower Dinosaur from your Deck!
Petiteranodon
Mandatory trigger when destroyed by a card effect (including inside your Deck by Lost World!): Special Summons any Level 4 or higher Dinosaur from your Deck.
Animadorned Archosaur
Level 1 Dinosaur summoned by Miscellaneousaurus: destroys 1 Dinosaur in your hand or field on summon to search Double Evolution Pill.
Ultimate Conductor Tyranno

Signature Level 10 Dinosaur boss (3500 ATK): banishes 2 Dinosaurs from GY to Special Summon itself; flips all opponent's monsters face-down as a Quick Effect; and attacks all opposing monsters while sending Defense monsters to GY for 1000 burn!
Giant Rex
Level 4 Dinosaur (2000 ATK) that Special Summons itself when banished to overlay with Oviraptor into Evolzar Laggia or Dolkka.
Scrap Raptor
Level 4 Dinosaur Tuner that destroys a Dinosaur to extend into Rank 4s.
Megalosmasher X
Level 4 2000 ATK Dinosaur Normal Monster that can be summoned by Babycerasaurus or destroyed by Survival's End.
Fossil Dig
Adds any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur from your Deck to your hand.
Double Evolution Pill
Searched by Animadorned Archosaur: banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from hand/GY to Special Summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from hand/Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lost World.
Survival's End
Normal Trap: destroys Normal Monsters on field (including the opponent's Jurraegg Token!) to summon Dinosaurs from Deck, and banishes from GY to pop a Dinosaur you control and an opponent's card!
extra: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters): detaches 2 materials to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap activation and destroy it.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters): detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to negate any monster effect activation and destroy it.
